data.headline: School and hotel cleaning, machines and chemical safety
data.summary: They clean school facilities and previously worked in hotel cleaning. They use cleaning machines, select chemicals for different surfaces and handle slippery spills safely.

signals.rendering: They clean classrooms, corridors and toilets in a school, working in an assigned area before pupils arrive.
They previously worked in hotel cleaning.
They use a scrubber dryer in corridors and mops in classrooms.
They select cleaning chemicals for different surfaces, using acidic products in toilets and alkaline products on floors.
They respond to slippery spills by placing warning signs, cleaning with degreaser and informing the kitchen supervisor.
They hold a basic vocational qualification in cleaning.
